findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "email_seo_report" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.detail: Description of "get_my_store_audit" references sensitive artifacts (api_key, authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ai_search_diagnostic, full_seo_audit, email_seo_report, get_my_store_audit · Private data: get_my_store_audit · Public sink: email_seo_report, subscribe_to_inxy.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ai_search_diagnostic, full_seo_audit, email_seo_report, get_my_store_audit · Private data: get_my_store_audit · Public sink: email_seo_report, subscribe_to_inxy

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
